title: ID0458653-DC/Si-D/EE-[MP / R2 170001468]Charger not able to be commissioned
description:
Multiple issues preventing commissioning of the charger
1.    Charger is booting up but when blue “Siemens” screen is visible, charger suddenly switches off and both LOGO relays are open.
2.    Middle door lock is somehow stuck and barely moves.
3.    Lowest door lock is “ON-state” and doesn’t move or lock. I assume the loose steelwire is reason for this.
